description: Default role tuples emitted by the openfga-bootstrap Helm-hook Job on a fresh store. Tuple syntax: object#relation@subject. Opaque IDs only — no email, no display name, no DNA.

default_role_tuples.reason: E3.2 — platform bootstrap account is OWNER of every new tenant (until first real user claims OWNER via invite redeem).
R16 §R16.2 — platform auditor (read-only audit) is granted at the tenant boundary; ABAC overlay enforces redaction.
R16 §R16.3 — JIT support tuple is time-bounded; the bootstrap Job re-issues it on every helm upgrade (idempotent) and the sync workflow revokes on issue close.
Quota / plan enforcement (E11.4) — billing service holds a tuple at the tenant boundary; ABAC overlay restricts to billing metadata only.

revoke_first_priority.rationale: E3.5 — on member-revoke or role downgrade the sync workflow DELETEs the affected tuples BEFORE inserting the new role tuples. Without this, a stale tuple can keep the user authorized for the duration of the eventual-consistency window.
